## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `pytest -q` pass locally
- [ ] Tests were written for the change (and fail without it)
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No DRM, paywall, login or CAPTCHA bypass; no telemetry; no secrets or large binaries
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are agreed in an issue and listed in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`
